fieldNotes.truckGate: Plant is fully perimeter-fenced (chain-link with barbed wire confirmed in Street View 2018/2024). The internal truck road off Quincy Ave (south) passes a gate/checkpoint structure with a canopy near the rail-car loading area (~41.7705,-88.1888) - a controlled truck entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A canopy-covered checkpoint structure stands at the truck gate lane (visible in Street View background, panos at 41.7694/-88.1895 and 41.7701/-88.1884). Consistent with a staffed guard booth/checkpoint; called true at medium confidence and flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The internal truck road runs a long distance from the Quincy Ave gate up to the docks and trailer yard - ample queue depth for 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide internal road and large open yard areas; physical room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors with trailers backed in on multiple building faces (NW face and others); estimate ~32, banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large U-shaped trailer drop yard on the west side, full of trailers parked in rows (z19 imagery at 41.7718,-88.1908); 60+ trailers visible, capacity ~100.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Rail receiving (flour hopper cars at the silos) is physically separate from the truck dock clusters.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail spur runs into the property; rail hopper/tank cars parked at the flour silos (z19 imagery at 41.7709,-88.1888). Corroborated by industrial-history source noting the Naperville plant 'is still rail served'.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Multiple buildings on the campus: the main bakery, a separate trailer-dock building to the N, and ancillary/utility structures.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified; left low-confidence.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Single shared in/out gate; outbound lane count not separately determinable.
